findings.description: findings sorted by severity then id

registered_tools.name: dapp_gas_buffer_check
registered_tools.purpose: Check the gas limit a UI submits: headroom over eth_estimateGas, block and protocol gas caps, estimate age and balance coverage of value plus gas_limit times maxFeePerGas.

findings.description: findings sorted by severity then id

agents.name: Web3 Custody & Compliance Engineer
agents.description: Designs custody and compliance controls: multisig and MPC policy, key ceremonies and rotation, timelocks, signer and transaction policy, sanctions screening and Travel Rule evidence. Policy and evidence only: never touches key material or moves funds.

registered_tools.name: custody_multisig_policy
registered_tools.purpose: Check an m-of-n multisig: threshold sanity, signer diversity by entity, region and device, and value-tiered signature requirements.

signer_id.description: unique signer identifier, never key material

entity.description: person or organization that controls the key

region.description: country or region where the key is held

required_signatures.description: approvals the policy demands inside the tier

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass

registered_tools.name: custody_timelock_check
registered_tools.purpose: Check a governance or treasury timelock: delay versus value at risk and response time, cancel path, admin role and expiry window.

delay_seconds.description: configured minimum delay between queue and execution

value_at_risk_usd.description: value the timelocked operations can move

delay_bands.description: policy: required delay by value at risk

min_value_usd.description: value from which the band applies (inclusive)

response_seconds.description: time to detect a malicious operation, decide and cancel it

guardian_can_cancel.description: an independent guardian can cancel queued operations

admin_renounced.description: the admin role is renounced or held only by the timelock itself

execution_window_seconds.description: time after the delay in which an operation can still run; 0 means it never expires

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass

registered_tools.name: custody_ceremony_checklist
registered_tools.purpose: Score a key-ceremony record against the checklist for its type: done, evidence reference and witnesses per item.

min_witnesses.description: independent witnesses required for in-room steps

item.description: checklist item id from the ceremony's catalogue

evidence_ref.description: reference to the evidence (record id, hash of a log, ticket), never key material; empty = none

missing_items.description: catalogue items not complete, in catalogue order

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass

registered_tools.name: custody_shard_distribution
registered_tools.purpose: Check a t-of-n secret-share distribution: loss and compromise tolerance and quorum independence by custodian, organization and country.

custodian.description: person or role holding the shard

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in capitals where the shard is stored

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass

registered_tools.name: custody_signer_policy_lint
registered_tools.purpose: Lint a signer policy: limits, allowlist enforcement, new-address cool-off, velocity, approval expiry and policy-change quorum.

daily_limit_usd.description: rolling 24 h limit; 0 means none configured

velocity_max_tx_per_hour.description: maximum transactions per hour; 0 means none configured

allowlist_enforced.description: transfers are only allowed to allowlisted destinations

allowlist_cooloff_seconds.description: delay before a newly allowlisted address can receive funds

allowlist_reattest_days.description: days between re-verification of allowlist entries; 0 means never

policy_change_approvals.description: approvals needed to change limits or the allowlist

approval_expiry_seconds.description: how long a collected approval stays valid; 0 means never expires

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass

registered_tools.name: custody_wallet_tier_caps
registered_tools.purpose: Check hot, warm and cold wallet balances against percentage and absolute caps and a minimum cold share; report what to sweep.

max_pct_of_total.description: cap as a percentage of the total across tiers

min_cold_pct.description: minimum share of the total held cold

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass

registered_tools.name: custody_key_rotation
registered_tools.purpose: Compare each key's age since creation or last rotation with its maximum age: overdue, due soon or ok.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm)

warn_days.description: a key with this many days or fewer left is due soon

key_id.description: key identifier or public address, never key material

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm)

last_rotated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset, or empty when there is none

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass

registered_tools.name: custody_tx_policy_eval
registered_tools.purpose: Evaluate a transaction descriptor against custody policy and return allow, hold or deny with reasons; it never signs.

chain_id.description: EIP-155 chain id of the transaction

to.description: destination, 0x + 40 hex; mixed case must satisfy EIP-55

selector.description: 4-byte function selector as 0x + 8 hex, empty for a plain transfer

destination_listed_seconds.description: time since the destination entered the allowlist; ignored when unlisted

spent_24h_usd.description: value already moved in the rolling 24 h

tx_count_1h.description: transactions already made in the rolling hour

allowed_chain_ids.description: EIP-155 chain ids the wallet may transact on

per_tx_limit_usd.description: deny above this value per transaction

daily_limit_usd.description: deny when the rolling 24 h total would exceed this

hold_above_usd.description: hold for manual review at or above this value

cooloff_seconds.description: time a destination must have been allowlisted

selector_signature.description: canonical signature of a known selector, unknown for others, empty when none

registered_tools.name: custody_sanctions_screening
registered_tools.purpose: Check sanctions screening records: list freshness at screening time, screening age and the action taken for each match state.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm)

max_list_age_hours.description: a list older than this when used is stale

max_screening_age_hours.description: a clear result older than this must be rerun

list_updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm)

screened_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm)

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass

registered_tools.name: custody_travel_rule
registered_tools.purpose: Check FATF Recommendation 16 originator and beneficiary data completeness for a transfer above the regime's threshold (comparison selects at_or_above or above); below it a missing name or account is reported as info.

amount.description: transfer value in the currency of the threshold

threshold.description: jurisdictional threshold above which the data must travel

originator_account.description: originator account or wallet address; empty when missing

originator_identifier.description: the identifier of that kind; empty when none

beneficiary_account.description: beneficiary account or wallet address; empty when missing

registered_tools.name: custody_audit_trail
registered_tools.purpose: Verify a custody audit trail: contiguous sequence, SHA-256 hash chain, ordered timestamps, who and what, independent approvals.

at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm)

action.description: what was done; empty when missing

prev_hash.description: hash of the preceding event, 64 lower-case hex

hash.description: hash of this event, 64 lower-case hex

min_approvals.description: independent approvals (excluding the actor) those actions need

genesis_hash.description: prev_hash expected on the first event; default 64 zeros

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass

registered_tools.name: custody_recovery_drill
registered_tools.purpose: Check recovery drill recency, outcome and recovery time per required scenario: never, failed, over target, overdue or current.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm)

max_age_days.description: a drill older than this is overdue

last_drill_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm)

passed.description: the last drill met its success criteria

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass

registered_tools.name: custody_secret_scan
registered_tools.purpose: Scan supplied file contents for private-key material and report path, line, kind and length only, never the value.

path.description: repository-relative path; a secret-shaped path is reported as <redacted-path-N>

verdict.description: fail on any major or blocker finding, warn on minor, else pass
